items.q: How long before I see SEO results?
items.a: Local map-pack movement typically shows in 30–60 days. Meaningful organic traffic and booked-appointment growth compound between month 3 and month 9. We publish a transparent rank + traffic report every month so you see the trend, not a black box.

items.q: Do you write the medical content, or do we?
items.a: We do. Every page is drafted by a medical copywriter and reviewed against E-E-A-T guidelines — condition, treatment, and procedure pages included. You approve every page before it publishes, and a board-certified dermatologist can co-sign it on request.

100%. We follow Google's Search Essentials and YMYL (Your Money or Your Life) guidance for medical sites. No PBNs, no cloaking, no AI spam, no fake reviews. Every link is editorial and every citation is verifiable.

items.q: Do you work with multi-location practices?
items.a: Yes. We build a scalable location architecture — one authoritative service page plus location-specific landers per city — with unique intros, staff, hours, and schema for each. This is how multi-site clinics dominate 8–20 cities without content cannibalization.

items.q: Will you integrate with my existing website?
items.a: Yes. We work on WordPress, Webflow, Modernizing Medicine, Nextech, custom stacks, or any CMS you already have. If your platform is holding rankings back, we'll say so — and offer a migration plan only if the ROI is clear.
